Chalet Motel 192 ofrece un concepto únic: Chalet Motel 192 offers a unique long-term rental concept in Kissimmee, Florida. We provide a safe, comfortable, and accessible space for extended stays of 6 months to 1 year.

Ubicado estratégicamente sobre la conoci: Strategically located on the famous highway 192 (Irlo Bronson Memorial Highway), we are just minutes away from major shopping centers, restaurants, and Central Florida's most famous tourist attractions, including Walt Disney World. Our motel has evolved from temporary lodging to a true community of long-term residents.
Ofrecer soluciones habitacionales a larg: To offer long-term housing solutions through competitive rates, top-class maintenance service, and a peaceful and clean environment that our residents can call home.
Consolidarnos como la principal opción d: To consolidate ourselves as the main option for long-term rental in Kissimmee, outstanding for the security of our facilities, the constant renewal of our spaces, and the warmth of our service.
A diferencia de los moteles tradicionale: Unlike traditional motels focused on passing tourists, at Chalet Motel 192 we specialize in long-term rentals from 6 months to 1 year. This approach allows us to foster a residential atmosphere of peace and mutual respect. Each of our rooms has the basic amenities that guarantee a hassle-free lifestyle: high-efficiency air conditioning, refrigerator, cable TV, high-speed wireless Internet, and ample parking for you and your visitors.
